data.name: AlFatih
data.gender_notes: AlFatih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islam, AlFatih is a title given to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, meaning ‘The Conquering One’, as he conquered the hearts and minds of people with the message of Allah. It is also a title given to rulers and leaders who successfully lead their people. The name AlFatih carries the meaning “The Conquering One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFatih usually hope their child will grow to embody the conquering one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and leadership, inspiring others to follow the righteous path.
data.etymology: AlFatih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Conquering One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFatih total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: AlFatih
in_english.meaning: Conferred by Allah upon whomever He wills, a name of Allah associated with victory and success.
in_english.long_meaning: AlFatih is a name of Allah that signifies victory and success, conferred upon whomever He wills. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance. It is often associated with the concept of divine favor and blessing, and is considered a source of strength and inspiration for those who bear it. In Islamic theology, AlFatih is one of the beautiful names of Allah, and is seen as a symbol of His power and majesty. The name AlFatih is also associated with the concept of barakah, or divine blessings, and is often invoked in prayers and supplications for success and prosperity.

Muslims around the world acknowledge and cherish this name as a symbol of greatness and success. People often name their children AlFatih as an expression of hope for their child's success and conquest of challenges in their lives.
